text:
Hi from Korea 🇰🇷

Many Koreans check their Saju — a traditional birth chart reading — before big life decisions.

Your birthday reveals your Day Master, one of 10 types.
Which one are you? 👇

Forget your star sign.
Korean Saju has 10 Day Masters:

🌳Tree 🌿Vine ☀️Sun 🕯Candle ⛰Mountain
🌾Field ⚔️Steel 💎Jewel 🌊River 🌧Rain

Find yours in 30 sec (link below) and tell me which one you got.

Ever seen a K-drama character visit a fortune teller before a wedding or a big move?

That's Saju 🇰🇷 Korea's traditional birth chart reading.

Want to know what yours says? 👇

Drop your birthday (YYYY/MM/DD) 👇
I'll tell you your Korean Day Master + your hidden strength in one line.
First 30 replies 🌙

Day Master starter pack 💎 Xin (The Jewel)

· notices every typo
· says "I'm fine" (not fine)
· has a 10-step skincare routine

Which type should I do next?

Saju measures 5 elements in you: Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water.

The one you're MISSING matters most.

Check yours (free, 30 sec) and reply with your missing element 👇

2027 is the year of the Fire Goat 🐑
In Korean Saju, these zodiac animals get a tailwind:

1. Rabbit (born 1975, 1987, 1999)
2. Pig (1971, 1983, 1995)
3. Horse (1978, 1990, 2002)

They 'combine' with the Goat, so things tend to click into place.

Yours? Reply 'me!' + your birthday and I'll read your 2027 in one line 🌙
(Born in Jan–early Feb? You may be the animal before.)
Follow so you don't miss your reply 🔔

What will 2027 bring you? 🐑

Drop your birthday (YYYY/MM/DD) and I'll read your 2027 theme with Korean Saju in one line.
(No birth time needed)

In Korea, many couples check their Saju compatibility (gunghap) before getting married 🇰🇷

Would you ever check compatibility before marrying someone?

Zodiac animals in for a big switch-up in 2027 🔄

1. Ox (born 1973, 1985, 1997)
2. Dog (1982, 1994, 2006)
3. Goat (1979, 1991, 2003)

They clash with the Goat year (Ox, Dog) or hit their own animal's year (Goat) — think moves, job changes, letting go of old ties. Not bad, just a 'switch lanes' year.

Yours? Reply 'me!' + your birthday 🌙

Your love pattern is written in your birth chart.

Reply with your birthday and I'll tell you the one habit you repeat in love 🌙 (first 30)

In Korea, there are actual Saju cafés where you get your birth chart read over coffee ☕🇰🇷

People check it before exams, new jobs, even weddings.

Would you try a Saju café? ☕

Which of the next 5 years is your best one? 🌟

Drop your birthday and I'll read it with Korean Saju.

Which Day Master do you think you are?

🌳Tree 🌿Vine ☀️Sun 🕯Candle ⛰Mountain
🌾Field ⚔️Steel 💎Jewel 🌊River 🌧Rain

Guess first, then drop your birthday — I'll tell you if you're right 👀

Saver or spender? 💰

Drop your birthday and I'll tell you your money habit based on your Korean Day Master. First 30 replies.

Every New Year, lots of Koreans get a 'new year fortune' reading 🎆

Do you have a new year ritual?

What's your hidden work superpower? 💼

Reply with your birthday and I'll tell you, based on your Korean Day Master.

K-drama question 🇰🇷

When a character visits a fortune teller before a big decision — would you do the same in real life?

Western astrology: your sun sign.
Korean Saju: your Day Master + your 5-element balance.

Same birthday, way more detail.
Curious? Drop your birthday and I'll read yours 👇

Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water.

In Korean Saju, everyone has all five — just in different amounts.
Too much Fire? Burnout. No Water? You forget to rest.

Which one are you missing? Drop your birthday and I'll check 👇
